Senses.Explanation: Huike recalls ancient seekers striking bones for marrow; later masters apply the same image to penetrating instruction, lineage style, and forceful scrutiny. Biographical recollection, hall speech, and lineage appraisal all preserve the bone-to-marrow sequence as a figure for penetrating or exacting action.
